name: Team pace and efficiency total
hypothesis_to_test: Team pace and efficiency predict game total points better than a base-rate forecast
required_inputs: Historical box scores and dates; opponent-adjusted efficiency; timestamped totals line
official_source_for_inputs: NBA Stat Glossary for definitions (S06); game results not reachable (Q-DATA-01)
blocking_reason: No historical results and no timestamped totals

name: Rating-based point margin
hypothesis_to_test: A rating model predicts margin better than home-court and base-rate baselines out of sample
required_inputs: Historical results; rest days from schedule dates; home/away; ratings
official_source_for_inputs: NBA schedule (S05) for dates; results not reachable

name: Calibrated moneyline probability
hypothesis_to_test: Model probabilities are calibrated and beat the market-implied probability net of vig
blocking_reason: No results and no timestamped prices

name: Injury-adjusted team margin
hypothesis_to_test: Official status changes shift team strength through lost rotation minutes
required_inputs: Injury status history; minutes by player; team results
official_source_for_inputs: Official injury reports (S01; S02) give status snapshots only; no archive
blocking_reason: No injury history and no minutes data

name: Points from minutes times rate
hypothesis_to_test: Predicted minutes times per-minute scoring rate gives a better points distribution than a base rate
required_inputs: Player box scores; minutes; prop lines with timestamps
official_source_for_inputs: NBA Stat Glossary (S06) for definitions; box scores not reachable
blocking_reason: No box scores and no prop prices

name: Rebounds and assists from role and minutes
hypothesis_to_test: Role and minutes predict rebounds and assists distributions better than a base rate
required_inputs: Player box scores; roles; minutes; prop lines
official_source_for_inputs: NBA Stat Glossary (S06); box scores not reachable
blocking_reason: No box scores and no prop prices

name: Two-leg cross-game parlay test
hypothesis_to_test: Measured joint frequency of two independent-looking legs differs from the product of marginals
required_inputs: Leg-level outcomes and prices for both legs; game dates

name: Teammate usage when a starter is out
hypothesis_to_test: A teammate's usage and points rise when a starter is listed Out
required_inputs: Injury status history; usage and points per player; game-level minutes
official_source_for_inputs: Official injury reports (S01; S02) give snapshots only
blocking_reason: No injury history and no usage data

name: Team total and star points dependence
hypothesis_to_test: Team points and a star's points are positively dependent; a naive product overstates the joint probability
required_inputs: Matched same-game box scores; same-game prices for both legs
blocking_reason: No matched data and no prices

name: Starter minutes in lopsided games
hypothesis_to_test: Starter minutes fall in games with large score margins, so prop minutes depend on score state
required_inputs: Quarter or play-by-play score state; minutes by player

name: Null baseline (control)
hypothesis_to_test: A strategy with no information must fail the gates; this checks the gate design against luck
required_inputs: Same volume and market mix as ST01-ST10; random or base-rate selection
blocking_reason: Must be run with real data to test the gates; expected to fail
